critique.evidence: Strong, cohesive cyber-lab art direction: restrained cyan/red/yellow accents, confident headline typography, clear red-vs-blue framing, and consistent card styling across viewports. However, desktop polish falls below demo-ready: the fraud phylogeny is extremely small inside a large empty panel, creating a visibly unfinished composition. Dense microcopy, chart labels, and mono headings are frequently too small or low-contrast, especially on mobile. Tablet/mobile reflow is coherent but produces a very long, visually repetitive stack. The global header is crisp, yet tablet/mobile navigation appears abruptly clipped into a MORE affordance, and contrast remains unverified for several header elements.
critique.fix: Enlarge or recompose the desktop phylogeny to use its panel, raise minimum text size and contrast for labels/body copy, tighten mobile vertical repetition, and make the responsive header transition to MORE feel intentional with clearer active-section treatment.
